card.name: Nouns after the/these/such in drug text
card.fires_on: A general noun such as drugs, medications, therapy, drug or parasite right after a determiner or preposition (the, these, such, prior to). It points back to something already named earlier in the sentence.

modes.label: Drugs after these/such
modes.description: The noun drugs or medications follows these, such or with, referring back to a drug group just listed.
modes.example: When such<< drugs>> are administered to a patient receiving piog

modes.label: Therapy after prior to
modes.description: The noun therapy follows prior to in a statement about tuberculosis testing before TNF-blocker treatment.
modes.example: Treatment of latent tuberculosis infection prior to<< therapy>> with TNF-blockers has been shown

modes.label: Other referring nouns
modes.description: The word the or a noun like parasite appears right where the thing named earlier is referred to again.
modes.example: Researchers have found a strain of bacteria that can infect mosquitoes and make them resistant to the malaria<< parasite>>.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens are a mixed set of unrelated words.
card.plain: It fires on a general noun like drugs or therapy that refers back to something just mentioned.
